description: PLAN.md (line 140) excludes ResultReference from extras-preservation with rationale "recursive / non-flat shapes". But ResultReference is a flat 3-field struct: resultOf, name, path. It is non-recursive. It IS on the JMAP wire (RFC 8620 §9). The PLAN.md rationale is wrong. The real reason is likely that ResultReference is part of the dispatcher/parse machinery and unknown vendor fields on it are nonsense (a vendor extension to the JSON Pointer path would need spec-level coordination). Fix: correct the PLAN.md rationale OR add the extras field. If keeping the exclusion, the rationale should be: "ResultReference fields are dispatcher inputs; an unknown field on a resultRef is either a no-op (silently dropped) or a server bug. Preserving it on round-trip would silently propagate the bug." Affects future contributors writing per-crate extras-preservation policy and copy-pasting the rationale.
title: ResultReference is in scope for extras-preservation but explicitly excluded with weak rationale
